FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 23
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 23 would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an undetermined
amount to reimburse counties for election expenses incurred for special primary elections held
for districts affected by redistricting of legislative or congressional districts outside of the
normal primary election schedule, as provided by this bill.
